title: Storage of medical gases.
officialText:
When required by the New York City Fire Code, a one-hour room shall be provided for the storage of medical gases inside of buildings, with the protected openings and ventilation provisions as required by the New York City Fire Code. EXPLOSION CONTROL REQUIREMENTSa
